name: CarPlay Ultra-Lite compatibility check
description: Read-only. Checks whether this head unit can run CarPlay Ultra-Lite and the E-GMP CarPlay EV Routing mod: the libraries they patch, the car framework's climate, seat, body and voice calls and listeners, the climate flag numbers, a few read-only climate values, and which of the mods are installed. Writes the report (cp-climate-check.md and .json) to the CarPlayUltraLite-Check folder on the USB stick. Changes nothing on the unit; remove it after use.
